Create raw result tables

bdy_raw_res_tables.Rd

Compute result tables (national and by group of colonies)

Usage

bdy_raw_res_tables(mod_out)

Arguments

mod_out

A list including for each species a list of 5 outputs. This can be directly obtained for multiple species using bdy_run_analysis(), or combined manually for each species within a loop (see Vignette for more details). For each species, the list must include:

  • no_impact: output of the demographic model with no impact from windfarms, from bdy_model_no_impact()

  • with_impact: output of the model with impact from windfarms, from bdy_model_with_impact()

  • colonies: data frame with each row being a colony where the species of interest is present, from bdy_process_count_data()

  • mortality: Matrix (rows = iterations, columns = groups of colonies) giving the distribution of mortality accross groups of colonies, from bdy_process_mortality()

  • distance: matrix giving the distances between colonies (rows) and wind farms (columns), from bdy_get_distances()

Value

Three tables:

  • Simulated_National: Simulated counts for the 30 projected years at national level (used to plot temporal trends with bdy_plot_trends())

  • Tableau_Subpop: Summary table of results by colony (with relative impact, increase in probability of extinction, mortality, etc)

  • Tableau_National: Summary table of results at national level (with relative impact, increase in probability of extinction, mortality, etc)


Relative impact was calculated for each iteration as 100*(C0-C1)/C0where C0 is the estimated abundance of the species after 30 years without windfarm impact and C1 is the estimated abundance of the species after 30 years with windfarm impact (the median across simulations is provided, as well as the confidence interval). Increase in extinction probability is calculated as 100*(P1-P0) where P0 is the probability of extinction without windfarm impact (calculated as the proportion of simulations that reach counts of 0 after 30 years) and P1 is the probability of extinction with windfarm impact.
